The '''Chaos Temple''' is a structure in level 38 [[Wilderness]], west of the [[Lava Maze]]. It contains a [[Chaos altar (Prayer)|Chaos altar]] where players can recharge and train their [[Prayer]] using [[Remains#Bones|bones]] on the altar (other [[remains]] such as [[Remains#Demonic ashes|demonic ashes]] do not work). Free players may visit the temple, however only members may take advantage of the altar's benefits.

Praying at the Chaos altar inside is a requirement for the [[Easy Wilderness Diary]].

==Transportation==
* Teleport via use of a [[burning amulet]]'s teleport to [[Lava Maze]] entrance and run south-west (be wary of player killers)
* Teleport via [[Ghorrock Teleport]] (Level 96 Magic) on [[Ancient Magicks]] and run south
* Teleport via [[Cemetery Teleport]] (Level 71 Magic) on the [[Arceuus spellbook]] and run north
* Players who have an [[Obelisk (Construction)|Obelisk]] in their [[player-owned house]] can use it to teleport to level 44 Wilderness and then run south
* If [[Wilderness Diary|Hard Wilderness Diary]] is complete, any Obelisk can be used to teleport to level 44 Wilderness and then run south

==Features==
[[File:Chaos Temple (hut).png|thumb|left|The Chaos Temple hut in Level 38 Wilderness]]
A [[wine of Zamorak]] spawns on a table inside the hut, which can only be obtained by casting [[Telekinetic Grab]]. Players who have completed the [[hard Wilderness Diary]] will receive them in noted form. The wine respawns approximately every 20 seconds.

Players who kill the [[Chaos Fanatic]] may use the Chaos altar to recharge their Prayer as it is very close.

Due to the altar's use for Prayer training while being in multi-combat, it is frequently targeted by [[Player killing|player killers]].

There is also the [[Elder Chaos druid (NPC)|Elder Chaos druid]] who can unnote any type of [[bones]] for a fee of {{Coins|50}} per bone.
{{Clear|left}}

==Chaos Altar==
[[Members]] can offer [[bones]] on the [[Chaos altar (Prayer)|Chaos altar]] in the Wilderness, granting 3.5x Prayer [[experience]] per bone, the same bonus as a [[gilded altar]] with two burners lit. However, every bone offered on the altar has a 50% chance to not be consumed, which can activate for the same bone repeatedly. Therefore, the average experience per bone is 2x the amount from a [[player-owned house]] [[gilded altar]] with both [[incense burner]]s lit, or 7x the normal burying experience.  When this effect activates and a bone is saved, the message {{Mes|The Dark Lord spares your sacrifice but still rewards you for your efforts.}} is displayed. It is recommended to buy extra bones to mitigate any bad luck with offerings. Players who buy 53% of the bones that they would need at a gilded altar with two burners lit have a ~97% chance to reach their goal.

The 5% Prayer experience bonus of the [[Zealot's robes]] stacks multiplicatively with the Chaos altar's bonus, yielding a 52.5% chance to not consume a bone, meaning they can effectively be sacrificed an average of 2.1 times. This results in an effective 7.37x the normal burying experience per bone.

=={{FloorNumber|uk=1|caps=y|nohelp=y}}==
The {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} is accessed from [[Lucien's camp]] during the quest [[While Guthix Sleeps]]. It cannot be accessed from the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} and is not considered part of the Wilderness PvP areas.
